commits.message: Turn the Windows operator into a real Notepad/Word desktop path.
Record the Lane 2 product SHA in HANDOFF.json.
Prove Notepad File Open, type/paste, Word/Excel identity, and focus return.
Record the Lane 2 live-proof SHA in HANDOFF.json.
Commit COMDLG32 filenames by keyboard paste so Save As writes the intended file.
Prefer Word document frames and paste when ValuePattern is missing.
Return a fail-closed receipt when file-dialog targeting misses, instead of raising.

payload_schemas.notes: path is owned-root relative. expected is document text. receipts hash values; they do not include raw document text.
sets clipboard then pastes only into the bound control (select-all then Ctrl+V). same OperatorAction contract as replace_text.

action is open or save_as. Relative paths resolve against owned_root. Filename is keyboard-pasted as a full path because COMDLG32 ignores ValuePattern SetValue. Open confirm is SplitButton automation_id 1. Save confirm is Button automation_id 1. Confirm Save As Yes is clicked only when the dialog text names the submitted basename.

real_substrate_proofs: Notepad open_artifact_and_assert hash match on WindowsApps Notepad.exe
replace_text, type, paste COMPLETED on DocumentControl Text editor RichEditD2DPT
File Open #32770 SplitButton landed hello-open-*.txt with matching normalized document hash

File Save As via fabric desktop.file_dialog COMPLETED; title hello-save-*.txt - Notepad; saved_exists true. COMDLG32 SetValue was a lie: Confirm named hello-open. Keyboard paste of the full path is what lands.
Word desktop.open rebound to OpusApp HWND, title lane2 [Compatibility Mode] - Word
Word find_document_control prefers _WwG; replace_text falls back to keyboard paste; readback_verified true
Excel /x unique workbook XLMAIN plus UIA cell value JARVIS lane2 excel
focus Word then Notepad focused=true, PIDs stable, not swapped
ProcessIdentityMismatch after killing demo Notepad PID
Explorer bind to lane2-demo - File Explorer and select item hello without killing owner shell explorer
Calculator One click and Close Calculator COMPLETED without killing ApplicationFrameHost
wait_until enabled COMPLETED; Word wrap TogglePattern click COMPLETED
cross_lane_assumptions: Lane 4 composes desktop.open_artifact_and_assert with owned-root relative path, allowlisted absolute executable, and expected document text.
ProcessIdentity is pid+create_time+live image path. Win11 Notepad live image is WindowsApps Notepad.exe, not System32 notepad.exe.
WindowIdentity.to_selector omits title because Notepad prefixes * when dirty.
desktop.open with show_window=true waits for a new window using the artifact stem in the title, then same-exe fresh window fallback. show_window=false does not bind a window.
Control string values are redacted to sha256/length in receipts. Compare document text with normalize_document_text (CRLF).
Single-instance reuse of a pre-existing app is FAILED existing_instance_reused, not adopted. Excel needs /x plus a unique workbook name to force a new instance.
File Open confirm is SplitButtonControl automation_id 1. Save As confirm is ButtonControl automation_id 1. Filename Edit is 1001 on Save As and 1148 on Open.

COMDLG32 File name ValuePattern.SetValue updates UIA but not the pending path. invoke_file_dialog pastes the full path. Confirm Save As Yes is only accepted when the dialog text contains the submitted basename.
desktop.file_dialog is the fabric verb wrapping invoke_file_dialog. Relative path is resolved against owned_root.
Word document surface is DocumentControl class _WwG with TextPattern, not a writable ValuePattern. replace_text falls back to keyboard paste.
paste selects all then pastes. type types at the caret. replace_text uses SetValue when writable, else paste, then Ctrl+End when SetValue ran.
Calculator is UWP hosted by ApplicationFrameHost.exe. Do not kill AFH. Close via Close Calculator. Never kill shell explorer PID 13212.
likely_conflicts: personal_operator._launch_process no longer requires live exe path == allowlisted path (App Execution Alias).
desktop.open now post-binds GUI file opens when show_window is true, matching title stem not full filename.
list_windows drops helper HWNDs including PopupHost, tooltips, Office chrome.
observe_main_window and focus prefer APPLICATION_FRAME_CLASSES (Notepad, OpusApp, XLMAIN, CabinetWClass).
find_document_control prefers named aliases, then DOCUMENT_FRAME_CLASSES (RichEditD2DPT, _WwG), then DocumentControl.
New fabric action kinds desktop.open_artifact_and_assert, desktop.control.paste, and desktop.file_dialog.
integration_order_notes: Land Lane 2 before Lane 4 cross-app compose that calls open_artifact_and_assert or desktop.file_dialog.
Lane 4 should call desktop.file_dialog with a bound window identity and owned-root relative or absolute path.
Lane 1 browser and Lane 3 GitHub are independent.
Do not merge this branch to main from this lane.
known_semantic_conflicts: Word may show Document Recovery chrome if a prior demo Word was killed. OpusApp frame still binds. python-docx files open as Compatibility Mode.

Excel cell paste into DataItem A1 raises Microsoft Excel #32770 'The data you're pasting isn't the same size as your selection.' Type into A1 does not commit. Formula Bar HasKeyboardFocus is not verified. Cell replace is not proven.
Word File is Ribbon ButtonControl File Tab, not a classic File menu. Backstage inspect hangs this UIA backend; Word Save As is not proven. Notepad Save As is the proven COMDLG32 path.
Win11 Notepad System32 notepad.exe is an App Execution Alias; stub PID is not the window PID.
next_highest_value_work: Excel A1 replace without the size-mismatch paste dialog (Formula Bar focus or F2 edit commit).
Word/Excel Save As through Ribbon Backstage without hanging the UIA tree walk.
Explorer invoke/open of a selected lane-owned file without adopting an extra unowned app.
Lane 4 compose of desktop.file_dialog with owned-root relative paths across apps.
